title: Dos & Don'ts / logo
slide_intent: Show prohibited changes alongside correct versions so small production choices do not erode recognition.
strategic_value: Consistent color, spacing and proportions can keep DB’s mark dependable across layouts.
demonstration: Three paired comparisons address logo color, separation from the sleeper and proportional scaling; incorrect examples are crossed out.
practical_value: Reject recoloring, overlap with sleepers and distorted scaling before publishing.
